caption: The drawing depicts a bird perched on a branch with several leaves and small round fruits. The bird's body is primarily a tan or light brown color, with a darker, bluish-black pattern on its wings and a similarly colored tail. The bird's beak is red, and its eye is black, with a small white area around it. The branch is brown, and the leaves attached to it vary from a dark brown to greenish-brown. Several small, rounded fruits or berries are red in color and are distributed among the leaves and branches. The background consists of a textured, muted beige or taupe area. The drawing is centered on a larger piece of paper, with ample blank space around it, and annotations are visible on the margins, including the word "SAMPLER" and dimensions written near the lower edge.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
